This folder intentionally does not include Microsoft's DirectShow BaseClasses source.

Copy the DirectShow BaseClasses files here from the Windows classic samples / Windows SDK samples.
You need files such as:

  streams.h
  source.cpp
  wxdebug.cpp
  wxlist.cpp
  wxutil.cpp
  combase.cpp
  dllentry.cpp
  mtype.cpp
  renbase.cpp
  amextra.cpp
  ctlutil.cpp
  transfrm.cpp
  pstream.cpp
  outputq.cpp
  pullpin.cpp

This project is only the custom virtual camera code and Zig build wrapper.
